handoff.objective: Audit the v4 stage-B correction, six-partition componentwise accounting, traffic equations, exact runtime closure, and phase budgets before source implementation.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether every displayed shape, operation component, traffic bucket, backend identity, partition cap, and mandatory census is arithmetically correct and complete.
constraints: Recompute all shape and census entries independently.
Check the mode-3 stage-B output shape and every two-stage multiplication formula.
Check componentwise aggregation and traffic reconciliation without scalar substitution.
Distinguish data, source, runtime-package, and OS-loader reads.
Check that every source-visible hash and diagnostic sample is target independent.
Treat all ceilings as invalidation gates, not performance evidence.
completion_gate: Every numeric census and shape entry reconciles.
Every operation component and traffic bucket has one aggregation rule.
The bound backend identity and overflow claim are reproducible.
No source phase can hide target or mutation reads.
No comparator can be read as a speedup claim.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
